مُسْتَقَرّ.m: so (there is) a place of dwelling

أُشْرِبُ.m: And they were made to drink

يُعَمَّرُ.m: he could be granted a life

بَلَوْ.m: And surely We will test you

أَعْنَتَ.m: surely He (could have) put you in difficulties

مُطَلَّقَٰت.m: And the women who are divorced

قَيُّوم.m: the Sustainer of all that exists

قُرْبَان.m: gods as a way of approach

تُقْسِطُ.m: you will be able to do justice

فَتِيل.m: (even as much as) a hair on a date-seed

نَقِير.m: (even as much as the) speck on a date seed

سَلَّطَ.m: surely He (would have) given them power

يُمَنِّي.m: and surely arouse desires in them

يُبَتِّكُ.m: so they will surely cut off

مُنْخَنِقَة.m: and that which is strangled (to death)

مَوْقُوذَة.m: and that which is hit fatally

مُتَرَدِّيَة.m: and that which has a fatal fall

نَطِيحَة.m: and that which is gored by horns

مُكَلِّبِين.m: ones who train animals to hunt

يُصَلَّبُ.m: and surely I will crucify you

اقْتَرَفْ.m: and so that they may commit

أَرْدَىٰ.m: so that they may ruin them

قَاسَمَ.m: And he swore (to) both of them

أَوْرَثَ.m: you have been made to inherit it

نَزَغَ.m: an evil suggestion comes to you

يُقَلِّلُ.m: and He made you (appear) as few

ثَبَّطَ.m: so He made them lag behind

يَسْتَنۢبِـُٔ.m: And they ask you to inform

أَلْزَمَ.m: should We compel you (to accept) it

مَرْجُوّ.m: the one in whom hope was placed

رَجَمْ.m: surely we would have stoned you

مُوَفُّو.m: will surely pay them in full

تُفَنِّدُ.m: you think me weakened in mind

أَسْكَن.m: And surely We will make you dwell

يَسْتَعْتِبُ.m: will be asked to make amends

أَصْفَىٰ.m: Then has your Lord chosen (for) you

فُجِّرَتْ.m: And We caused to gush forth

وَرِق.m: with this silver coin of yours

تَمَثَّلَ.m: then he assumed for her the likeness

فَهَّمْ.m: And We gave understanding of it

قَانِع.m: the needy who do not ask

يُنَٰزِعُ.m: So let them not dispute with you

مَطْلُوب.m: and the one who is sought

كِبْر.m: took upon himself a greater share of it

وَكَزَ.m: so Musa struck him with his fist

يَسْتَصْرِخُ.m: cried out to him for help

مُتَصَدِّقَٰت.m: and the women who give charity

قِطْمِير.m: (as much as) the membrane of a date-seed

صَرِيخ.m: (would be) a responder to a cry

مُغْتَسَل.m: (is a spring of) water to bathe

مُقْوِين.m: for the wayfarers in the desert

مُصَّدِّقَٰت.m: and the women who give charity

تَعِيَ.m: and would be conscious of it

يُبَصَّرُ.m: They will be made to see each other

شَوَىٰ.m: of the skin of the head

أُقِّتَتْ.m: are gathered to their appointed time

سَٰبِقَٰت.m: And those who race each other

أَقْبَرَ.m: and provides a grave for him

يُجَنَّبُ.m: But will be removed from it

عَصْر.m: Time / late afternoon / the epoch of ages

كَوْثَر.m: The boundless abundance of all goodness

أَبْتَر.m: Severed of lineage, memory, and good

فَلَق.m: The daybreak / cleaving of the dawn

خَنَّاس.m: The one who slinks away and retreats

1:1: In the name of Allah, the All-Beneficent, the All-Merciful.
1:2: All praise belongs exclusively to Allah, Lord and Sustainer of all existence.
1:4: Sovereign Ruler of the Day of Recompense.
1:5: You alone do we worship and obey, and You alone do we beseech for ultimate assistance.
1:6: Guide us firmly along the Straight Path,
1:7: صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
The path of those upon whom You have showered Your grace, not of those who incurred wrath, nor of those who lost…
2:2: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
This Book has no doubt in it - a guidance for the God-fearing,
2:3: ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ…
who believe in the Unseen, and are steadfast in Salāh (prayer), and spend out of what We have provided them;
2:4: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ…
and who believe in what has been revealed to you and what has been revealed before you; and they have faith in the…
2:5: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
It is these who are guided by their Lord; and it is just these who are successful.
2:6: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا…
Surely for those who have disbelieved, it is all the same whether you warn them or you warn them not: they do not…
2:7: خَتَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَعَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِمْ ۖ وَعَلَىٰٓ أَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ…
Allah has set a seal on their hearts and on their hearing; and on their eyes there is a covering, and for them…
2:8: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ وَمَا هُم…
And among men there are some who say, “We believe in Allah and in the Last Day”, yet they are not believers.
2:9: يُخَـٰدِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَمَا يَخْدَعُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا…
They try to deceive Allah and those who believe, while they are not deceiving anyone except themselves, although…
2:10: فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ فَزَادَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَرَضًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا…
In their hearts there is a malady, so Allah has made them grow in their malady; and for them there is a grievous…
2:11: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُصْلِحُونَ
When it is said to them, “Do not spread disorder on the earth”, they say, “We are but reformers.”
2:12: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْسِدُونَ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
Beware, it is, in fact, they who spread disorder, but they do not appreciate.
2:13: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ ءَامِنُوا۟ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلنَّاسُ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ كَمَآ…
And when it is said to them, “Believe as people have believed,” they say, “Shall we believe as the fools have…
2:14: وَإِذَا لَقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ…
When they meet those who believe, they say, “We have entered Faith;” but when they are alone with their satans,…
2:15: ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَهْزِئُ بِهِمْ وَيَمُدُّهُمْ فِى طُغْيَـٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
It is Allah who mocks at them, and lets them go on wandering blindly in their rebellion.
2:16: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلضَّلَـٰلَةَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت…
These are the people who have bought error at the price of guidance; so their trade has brought no gain, nor have…
